acceptance_condition: A structured report covering (a)-(d) with effect directions and statistics and explicit PDF page markers from papers/text/lorenz-et-al-2011-social-influence.txt.
rationale: This is the causal-mechanism keystone for the 'open shared transcript destroys diversity' pathway in the D3 causal model; it is human evidence, so it must be flagged as cross-domain inference when applied to LLM agents.
text: What does Lorenz et al. 2011 'How Social Influence Can Undermine the Wisdom of Crowd Effect' establish? Extract: (a) experimental design (estimation tasks, subjects, information conditions: no information, aggregate information, full information); (b) the quantified effects of social influence on accuracy, on diversity/range reduction, and on confidence, with numbers; (c) the mechanism by which social influence narrows diversity without improving collective accuracy; (d) conditions under which influence helped versus hurt.
